title: Bonded Loft
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Bonded Loft and the helm marks Bonded Loft. Do: Close on Bonded Loft. The warehouse patrol hails. Sealing a layer is the Ledger contract. This job is the visit that opens the bond. Finish: come inside Bonded Loft's shell. The Compact writes standing. The scan contract still wants one sealed layer. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
